title: Sensitivity Summary (what-if levers)
description: Machine-readable sensitivity COEFFICIENTS the earnings-sensitivity orb (07_earnings-sensitivity) has already extracted, emitted alongside its markdown so the cockpit chat can answer what-if questions ('Adjusted EBITDA / operating margin if the aluminium price moves +$45/mt?') DETERMINISTICALLY. The number is never produced by the language model: scripts/sensitivity_math.py scales the recorded per-unit coefficient linearly, exactly as scripts/valuation_math.py recomputes fair value from valuation_summary.json. Each sensitivity carries the orb's own confidence, source, valid scenario range, and non-linearity note so a modelled answer is as reliable as the disclosed coefficient it scales, and no more.

base_metric.description: the metric the coefficients move (e.g. adjusted_ebitda_nok_m) — cite the exact basis; a coefficient on Adjusted EBITDA is not interchangeable with one on reported EBITDA (CLAUDE.md §15)

base_value.description: the base level of base_metric the deltas apply to (e.g. FY2025 Adjusted EBITDA)

base_value_source.description: citation for base_value itself (the starting level every new_value builds on), CLAUDE.md §5 — distinct from a coefficient's source, which cites the per-unit rate, not the base. A modeled new_value cannot be attributed without it.

base_period.description: the period base_value is for (e.g. FY2025)

revenue_base.description: revenue base for the margin scenario, same period/currency as base_value; null = margin is Not assessable (only the base_metric scenario is returned). Revenue is held CONSTANT (there is no revenue coefficient), so the engine reports margin_basis: revenue_constant — an implied margin at unchanged revenue, never a fully-modeled margin.

revenue_period.description: the period revenue_base is for; MUST equal base_period when a margin is computed (mixing e.g. FY25 profit with FY24 revenue is a §15 defect the guard rejects)

variable.description: stable machine key, snake_case (e.g. lme_aluminium_price) — what the chat/engine looks up

unit.description: the variable's own unit the delta is expressed in (e.g. USD/mt, NOK for USD/NOK, kmt)

base_value.description: current level of the variable (for context; not used by the linear scale)

coefficient.description: change in base_metric per ONE unit of the variable — the orb's disclosed/derived per-unit rate (e.g. NOK 15m Adj. EBITDA per USD 1/mt = the disclosed 'NOK 150m per USD 10/mt')

impact_metric.description: the metric the coefficient moves, if different from the sidecar base_metric

confidence.description: the orb's confidence in this coefficient — carried into every modelled answer

basis.description: 'company-disclosed' (a filed per-unit sensitivity) or 'inferred' (derived by the orb; lowers confidence)

valid_range.description: the delta band the orb actually disclosed a scenario for; a linear scale outside it is flagged, not silently trusted

non_linearity.description: any disclosed non-linearity (pricing lag, operating deleverage, asymmetric downside) carried into the answer

source.description: citation the coefficient came from (CLAUDE.md §5), e.g. 'FY2025 Annual Report, p.38'

mitigation_basis.description: CLAUDE.md §9 — what management response the coefficient EMBEDS, mirroring the orb's 'Mitigation assumed' column. zero_bound = gross, response held at zero: a BOUND, not a forecast. realised_offset = already net of the realised_offset_pct measured from the filings. disclosed_zero = the company itself discloses no response, so 0% is a measurement. not_applicable = no response channel (e.g. the row IS the response channel). disclosed_positions = a company-disclosed coefficient includes the source's existing hedge/risk-management positions, held at their source snapshot; gross exposure and a measured gross-to-net offset are unavailable. Its bound assumes zero ADDITIONAL management response only, not gross zero response or a proven worst-case outcome. Required for sidecars dated on/after 2026-11-14 (scripts/sensitivity_summary_checks.py MITIGATION_REQUIRED_DATE). Absent on a legacy row → the engine labels it an unrecorded zero-mitigation bound.

mitigation_scope.description: For disclosed_positions, REQUIRED exact value fixed_existing_positions_no_additional_response. Existing source positions remain included; no additional management response is modelled, an analyst assumption rather than a company forecast. This scope does not change the meanings of the other mitigation states.

embedded_hedges.description: For disclosed_positions, REQUIRED nonblank description of the hedge/risk-management positions the cited source says the coefficient includes. Do not invent per-channel contributions or treat these positions as a measured realised offset.

embedded_hedges_as_of.description: For disclosed_positions, REQUIRED real ISO calendar date YYYY-MM-DD of the source positions, not the question date or refreshed current positions. Schema validators must enable date-format validation; the shared runtime/integrity check also enforces a real calendar date.

realised_offset_pct.description: the realised offset measured from the filings, 1 − (observed impact ÷ gross pre-mitigation impact), as a percent. With zero_bound: optional; when present the engine computes the realised case BESIDE the bound. With realised_offset: REQUIRED and < 100; the engine shows the gross bound beside the net figure. Must be null/0 for disclosed_zero and not_applicable. For disclosed_positions, ABSENT or NULL only: every non-null value, including 0, is invalid because no measured offset is claimed. Never derived from 'no contractual pass-through', which is a fact about contracts, not a measurement.

realised_offset_source.description: §5 citation for the periods and figures realised_offset_pct was measured from — REQUIRED whenever a non-zero offset is recorded. For disclosed_positions, ABSENT or NULL only; every non-null value, including blank text, is invalid.
